reviewerName: Codex AI-assisted editor synthesizing independent Luna and Terra reviews
note: Two independent AI-assisted reviewers evaluated the exact pack hash, matching source row, and schema. The recorded evidence synthesizes their findings and a source-level consistency check. Review is not human or learner validation. The rights/authorship statement is locally declared and not independently verified. Requested Luna route was not exposed (runtime-visible model label GPT-6); Terra route was gpt-5.6-terra (runtime label Codex GPT-6).
